officialTitle: Request to Make Case Records Confidential or Sealed Under Administrative Rule 37.6

howTheCorpusWasRecovered.note: Recovered from the pinned private release into the git-ignored private tree. Nothing was fetched from a court or agency host, and no mirror, cache or aggregator was consulted. No source binary is committed; `private/` is git-ignored and tracks nothing.

pinnedIdentity.corroborationResult: All four independent records state the same digest and the same byte length. The pinned identity is internally consistent.

observedIdentity.measuredBy: first-hand inspection of the mounted binary in this build

gateDiscriminationProof.why: A gate that refuses unconditionally proves nothing about the thing it refused. All four branches were exercised against synthetic roots before this verdict was recorded.

branches.VERIFIED: exit 0 when mounted bytes hash to the pinned digest
branches.DIGEST_MISMATCH: exit 3 when mounted bytes hash to anything else
branches.SOURCE_BYTES_ABSENT: exit 2 when the index pins a digest and the bytes are not mounted
branches.INDEX_ENTRY_ABSENT: exit 4 when the corpus index names no such entry

gateDiscriminationProof.result: All four discriminate. SOURCE_BYTES_ABSENT is a positive finding of absence, not a degenerate default.

whyThisVerdictIsWorthSomething: The gate's four branches were exercised against synthetic roots before the earlier refusal was recorded, so VERIFIED here is a discriminating result rather than a default. The same argument was then applied to the BUILD's own verification, which reports zero findings: see reports/verification-discrimination.json, where every role refusal is dropped in turn and ink is injected directly into the hard-blank fields and controls. A check that cannot fail is not a check.

priorVerdict.whyItWasCorrect: A true finding about that container: the Master Library was not mounted, so the pinned digest had nothing to verify against. An absent file is not a verified one and is not an empty one. It was not a fact about the corpus — the bytes were in a private release each container must recover for itself, which the brief did not say at the time.
absenceEvidence: private/ does not exist in this checkout.
private/ is git-ignored at .gitignore:53, and `git ls-files` tracks 0 paths beneath it, so no clone of this repository can carry the bytes.
The operational tree private/Nationwide Record Clearing is likewise absent; scripts/rcap-official-forms/operational-corpus-precondition.mjs reports exists:false for both trees.
scripts/rcap-all50-overlay-factory-lib.mjs:568 assertSourceDir() throws `Nationwide source directory not found` for this same absence.
A filesystem-wide sweep found no file of the pinned length 130602 bytes and no Master Library or Nationwide tree at any path.
OFFICIAL_FORMS_SOURCE_DIR and RCAP_MASTER_LIBRARY_DIR are both unset.
Egress to court hosts is refused in this environment and re-acquisition was not attempted; the build order forbids acquiring anything.
whyThisStoppedTheBuild: The build order's first step is verify-or-stop, and an unverifiable absence is strictly weaker than a mismatch: there is nothing to compare.

Steps 2, 3, 6, 7 and 8 all consume the source binary. Field geometry must be measured off the document, fixtures must be rendered from it, and verification must read the resulting artifact bytes. None of that is reachable without the file.
OFFICIAL_FORM_MAP_REQUIRED cannot be discharged by a map whose write boxes were not measured, and ARTIFACT_REVIEW_REQUIRED cannot be discharged with no artifact to review.

Recording the remaining work types as complete on documentary grounds alone would reproduce the exact failure named in operational-corpus-precondition.mjs: a missing directory read as a passing condition.

The geometry was MEASURED here rather than copied forward — see field-census.census-v1.json#productionOverlayCrossCheck for the row-by-row comparison.
corroborationAgainstTheProductionOverlay.whereTheyDiffer: The production census records one widget per field. This one records all 29. The two it omits are caseNo on pages 2 and 3 and the second Group1 radio widget — the substance of inherited finding F3, and the reason verification here reads every widget.
